title: Module 5: 《Blood Debt》
subtitle: Multi-Session Solo Narrative Gauntlet of Choices & Consequence
description: A multi-session narrative solo module divided into three acts: Act I 'The Ruins' (choice about survivors), Act II 'The Trail' (choice regarding the bandit leader), and Act III 'The Reckoning' (final boss identity morphs based on choices). Death halves gold earned this run and increases blood_debt by 1, while retaining all permanent upgrades and narrative items.

options.text: Accept Bribe & Let Him Escape (+120 GP)

bossConfrontation.rule: Identity dynamically forged from Act I & Act II narrative flags

permutations.bossName: Malakar, Warlord of the Red Vengeance
permutations.theme: The bandit leader returns leading an enraged warband.

permutations.bossName: The Vengeful Wraith of the Unburied
permutations.theme: Spirits of the murdered innocents coalesce into a necrotic avenger.

permutations.bossName: Commander Kaelen, Grand Arbiter of the Debt
permutations.theme: An honorable judicial martial trial settling the crimson debt.

permutations.bossName: The Arbiter of the Blood Debt
permutations.theme: The ancient construct guardian of the eternal scales.

environmentalSummary.hazardRule: Unstable footing deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 12 DEX save).
environmentalSummary.trapRule: Hidden pressure wire deals 2d6 piercing and immobilizes (DC 12 Perception, DC 13 Thievery).
environmentalSummary.bossMechanicRule: The boss identity, abilities, and dialogue morph directly based on choices in Acts I & II.
